retrievalProfile.description: A centered, aggressive animal portrait emerging from a circular metallic frame against a solid dark background with high-contrast chrome lettering.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central circular portal featuring a detailed, aggressive lion's head with a thick mane, biting into a tattered flag. The entire composition is set against a deep black void, topped with metallic, high-shine serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a circular metallic frame
Typography positioned at the top center, overlapping the black background
High contrast between the warm tones of the lion and the cold chrome of the frame and text
Aggressive diagonal movement created by the lion's head and the tattered flag
coreInvariants: Circular metallic border framing the subject
Chrome-effect serif typography with high-specular highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central circular emblem occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The lion's face and open mouth biting the flag.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bright chrome text at the top, down to the lion's eyes, and finally to the tattered flag at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive solid black space surrounding the central emblem and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the black background and the metallic highlights; high saturation in the lion's mane and flag.

letterConstructionRules: Thick vertical strokes with sharp, bracketed serifs
High-contrast transitions between thick and thin strokes
Integrated chrome gradient effect with sharp horizontal light breaks
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are tightly kerned to the point of touching or overlapping
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single heavy display face for maximum impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, rounded serif structure common in 70s rock art.
Provides the necessary slab-serif weight and authority.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a detailed airbrushed illustration of a roaring lion's head biting a tattered flag, centered inside a circular chrome frame, all set against a solid black background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered, uppercase, heavy serif text at the top in a polished chrome style with horizontal light reflections.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a metallic chrome gradient?
Is the lion contained within a circular frame?
Are the serifs on the text sharp and prominent?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome effect on the text looks reflective.
Verify the lion's expression is aggressive and detailed.
Check that the circular frame is perfectly centered.
Confirm the background is a solid, deep black.
recipe.reuseFormula: Aggressive [Animal] + [Object] in Mouth + Circular Chrome Frame + Chrome Serif Typography + Black Background
